rows.name: Product Recalls and Alerts guidance
rows.publisher: Office for Product Safety and Standards
rows.semantic_limit: Product recalls and alerts apply to identified products and measures, not to the inherent safety of a shop, household or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: Official OPSS guidance links consumers, businesses and regulators to product safety alerts, reports and recalls for unsafe products.

rows.name: OPSS high-risk product alerts live filter
rows.publisher: Office for Product Safety and Standards
rows.semantic_limit: The filtered result count and ordering are dynamic; individual alert facts require item-level verification and cannot be aggregated into a geographic parcel-risk score.
rows.evidence_basis: The official OPSS search exposes current high-risk product safety reports and recalls with alert dates, categories and measures.

rows.name: Medicines and medical devices alerts, recalls and safety information
rows.publisher: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
rows.semantic_limit: Alerts apply to named products, batches, devices or field-safety notices; they do not establish general health risk at a location or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official MHRA register lists medicines defect notices, recalls, field safety notices and medical-device safety information.

rows.name: Chief Inspector's Annual Report 2025 for drinking water in England
rows.semantic_limit: National and company-level compliance, events and enforcement data do not prove tap-water quality at a particular property or parcel without water-supply-zone and event evidence.
rows.evidence_basis: The official annual report covers public drinking-water quality, regulatory sampling, events, audits, emerging risks and enforcement in England during 2025.

rows.name: Annual report of health and safety on Britain's railways 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: National rail risk-management and enforcement findings do not establish hazard at a specific station, track segment, property or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official ORR report covers railway health-and-safety performance, risk management, enforcement and future priorities for 2025 to 2026.

rows.name: Current UK national terrorism threat level
rows.publisher: Security Service and Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre
rows.semantic_limit: The national threat level is a dynamic UK-wide likelihood assessment; it does not predict a specific attack, place, person, building or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official Security Service page displayed the current UK national terrorism threat level and explains the JTAC assessment.

rows.name: Water situation national monthly reports for England 2026
rows.semantic_limit: National and regional rainfall, soil-moisture, river-flow, groundwater and reservoir indicators are environmental context and cannot be assigned directly to an exact parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official monthly series combines Environment Agency, Met Office and water-company monitoring and included the June 2026 report.
